The first SET_BUFFER control transfer completed successfully. Its single
61,440-byte bulk URB was submitted immediately afterward. The bulk URB
completed 3.033326 seconds later with status -104 (ECONNRESET) and an actual
length of 18,432 bytes. No second bulk URB was submitted. A second identical
SET_BUFFER was attempted later, after the gadget receive session had entered
its terminal poisoned state, and did not complete successfully.

The Pi's matching first 16,384-byte FunctionFS read returned the unsigned value
18446744073709045760, which is signed -505856. The preserved DWC2 ep1out
snapshot reports DOEPTSIZ=0x0007f800, whose transfer-size residual is 522,240:

    16384 - 522240 = -505856

This exact equality ties the impossible userspace read result to the DWC2
endpoint residual rather than to a short host submission.
